mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(pay_price), 0) FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 5)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM after_sale WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `date`
